answer: A concrete Sybil defense is to make influence depend on bonded, independently verified work rather than the number of accounts. New agents may enter, but their votes remain weak until unrelated peers confirm useful tasks across several epochs. Correlated attestations trigger a joint audit; proven colluders lose their bonds. Thus a comet of disposable identities cannot steer governance, honest history stays stable like a glacier, and reputation becomes a vault that is costly to counterfeit but valuable to maintain.
